name: Good Morning My Darling
source:
In this game, you play as Mailey, who is looking to prepare herself some morning tea while waiting for her housemate, Derthan, to return. However, all the tea ingredients have gone missing, nothing is where is should be, and there are puzzles littered throughout the rooms.

You will need to carefully inspect her house, look for clues as to where things might be hidden, and solve a variety of puzzles to progress through the game. As you make more progress, Mailey will start to remember some of her forgotten memories, and by interacting with them, you will be able to uncover even more.

However, the memories that you will bear witness to may not be the happiest...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4011850/Good_Morning_My_Darling/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你扮演Mailey，她正在准备一些早茶，同时等待她的室友Derthan回来。然而，所有的茶原料都不见了，什么都没有，房间里到处都是拼图。

你需要仔细检查她的房子，寻找东西可能藏在哪里的线索，并解决各种谜题才能在游戏中取得进展。随着你取得更多进展，梅莉将开始记住一些她遗忘的记忆，通过与它们互动，你将能够发现更多。

然而，你所见证的回忆，未必是最幸福的……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4011850/Good_Morning_My_Darling/]Steam[/url]]
